description: P4-M3-T02 corpus pair list: STEP export fixtures to validate against the independent reader (Open CASCADE via corpus/tools/occ_probe, the kernel FreeCAD uses for STEP import). Each pair's 'step' is measured by the independent reader and compared to the committed golden in corpus/export-validation-golden.json.

pairs.source: P6-M4-T01 faceted AP214 passthrough export of the CC0 isolith unit box (8 verts / 12 tris), byte-locked to the independent encoder. As of this card OCC parses it (status Done, 1 root) but transfers NO shape (SHAPE_REPRESENTATION_RELATIONSHIP wiring -> golden transfer=false).

Same unit-box geometry, re-wired to the OCC-transferable AP214 form (MANIFOLD_SURFACE_SHAPE_REPRESENTATION + SHAPE_DEFINITION_REPRESENTATION) by corpus/tools/gen_convention_step.py from the committed export. Proves the exporter's GEOMETRY is sound and isolates the drift to the representation wiring; sets the target for exporter follow-up (P4-M3-T01).
